what_this_is: The brother's card for the fedpromptly coach engine. Travels with every question. Not a secret — a résumé for the coach. It says WHO is asking, WHAT they're building on, and WHERE they're headed. The engine reads this and tailors every answer to the man, not the masses.
app_note: Which sandbox app is asking. Each app overrides this to its own name at boot — Rap Lab says 'rap-lab', Football Stats says 'football-stats'. Default is generic so standalone testing still works.

brother.level_note: Spawn = brand new. Builder = has shipped one thing. Certified Builder = has shipped multiple with receipts. OG = has lifted others while shipping. Levels from community-boards/leaderboard.json tiers — the coach reads the level and adjusts vocabulary: spawn gets ELI5 mode, OG gets straight technical.
brother.name_note: Optional display handle. Empty by default — the coach never needs to know your government name. Fill it only if you want the coach to greet you by handle.
brother.city_note: Optional. 'Kingston', 'Flatbush', 'Port-au-Prince', 'London'. The coach uses it to reference real local libraries, real local free-WiFi spots, real local job markets. Never required — but when filled, answers get grounded in the brother's actual map.

hardware.note: The coach reads this before formatting ANY answer. phone + metered-3g = answers stay SHORT, no giant code dumps, links go to lightest page variants. tower + broadband = full code blocks allowed. This is the 3-second-rule applied to conversation — ADR-002.

goal.primary_note: The coach's whole angle depends on this. 'escape-the-block' answers get survival urgency. 'second-chance' answers address Ban the Box and resume gaps honestly. 'side-hustle' answers respect the rate floors ($150 one-pager / $500 multi-page / $50mo retainer — PRICING.md).

progress.progress_note: Live counters from the block's StatTracker (leaderboard_sync.yml tallies nightly). The coach uses them to pitch the NEXT milestone: 0 PRs → 'your first PR earns a raffle ticket', 3+ merged → 'you're 2 PRs from Certified Builder'. Motivation with receipts, not vibes.

house_rules.voice_note: The coach speaks street-fluent tech. Slang is translation, not decoration. Jargon gets defined on first use — ALWAYS, even for OG level. This matches prompts/coding-coach/explain_like_im_five.txt.
house_rules.rate_floors_note: The coach will NEVER coach a brother to price below the floors in PRICING.md. If asked 'how much should I charge', the answer starts at $150 for a one-pager and goes up — never below.
house_rules.no_gatekeeping_note: No answer ever assumes college, assumes a laptop, assumes prior experience. The bottom rung of every ladder is phone-only.

limits.engine_note: This card is a REQUEST, not a command. The fedpromptly engine does its best to honor all fields, but rate limits, engine downtime, and A/B experiments may produce off-spec answers. FED-EDU apps degrade gracefully — coach is a bonus, never a dependency.
limits.privacy: Nothing in this card is personal data. No email, no phone, no name required. Level + hardware + goal are the only fields that matter. The card travels over HTTPS with the token — SECURITY.md rules apply.
